Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: preliminary telemetry - KV-cache miss storm; possible model routing regression

Quick summary from telemetry (09:00-09:30 ET window):
- Large uptick in KV-cache miss rate for the V2 routing group (p99 miss from 2% -> 22%).
- Model variant selector observed frequent fallbacks to a quantized variant that has a known slower tail on long sequences.
- Autoscaler didn't trigger additional warm nodes fast enough due to a threshold configuration change last week (OP-7821).

Proposed immediate actions (can be executed in parallel):
1) Roll back routing selector to pinned variant @ 08:30 snapshot (mitigates misses).
2) Temporarily increase scale-out aggressiveness for Resonant Health pool (add 3 warm instances).
3) Disable quantized-fallback for high-latency endpoints until we validate tail behavior.

I'll attach a heap dump and kernel traces in a follow-up (kvcache_miss_heap_dump.tar.gz). If we do 1+2 now we should see p95 fall back under 350ms within ~20-30 minutes.

Karthik Iyer
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Incident update: rollback complete, metrics returning to normal, next steps

Samira / Tom — quick update following the bridge and mitigation work.

What we did (completed ~11:15 ET):
- Rolled back the routing selector to 08:30 snapshot (completed without service restart).
- Increased pool by +3 warm instances and adjusted autoscaler thresholds.
- Disabled quantized-fallback for the affected endpoints.

Immediate results:
- P95 fell from ~1.4s -> 320ms within 18 minutes of rollback.
- 5xx rate returned to 0.28% and continues to trend downward.
- No consumer-facing downtime observed; a small fraction of in-flight requests (~0.4%) were retried as part of failover logic.

Next steps / deliverables:
- Deliverable by 16:00 ET: postmortem draft (link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/rhn-2028-042/telemetry) and remediation timeline.
- Deliverable by EOD: SLA credit estimate (sla_credit-estimate.xlsx attached).
- Follow-up: full RCA and code-level fix for selector logic (OP-7821) targeted in next sprint.

If you want a signed SLA credit agreement or formal escalation letter, procurement@resonanthealth.com can expect a DocuSign link by EOD.

I'll keep this thread as the single-source status channel. You're also welcome to reach me directly at +1 415 555 0198 for the bridge or urgent items.

Thanks for your patience — we'll follow up with a clean postmortem and the remediation plan.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Customer Reliability
